title: The Legacy of Hungarian Political Thought Today
grammar: Academic synthesis of cleft identification and causal governance
goal: I can say what many interpreters see as the common message of the four thinkers.
I can use *nem más, mint*, *éppen az, ami*, *abban rejlik, hogy* and *abból adódóan, hogy* in one short text.
I can report how commentators today use the four thinkers' ideas, naming whose view it is.
